highlights: The Recci RCS-S11 laptop bag prioritizes functionality with its spacious interior, specifically designed for 16-inch laptops.
The Recci RCS-S06 laptop bag prioritizes functionality with its spacious interior, specifically designed for 14-inch laptops.
Its two-layer construction and minimalist design offer an elegant look for both work and everyday use, while allowing you to carry your computer and accessories neatly.
Whether you walk to the office or use public transport, this bag complements your style and gives you the freedom to carry everything you need.
Waterproof design makes it ready for all weather conditions.
Thanks to its high-density, tear-resistant polyester fabric, the Recci bag provides extra protection against both water and impacts.

The ultra-soft plush lining inside protects your device from scratches and absorbs shocks upon impact. You can safely carry your laptop, especially at outdoor meetings or on rainy days, and be prepared for everyday surprises.
